text:
deploy-bot: initiating staged rollout v3.2.4 -> 5% eu-central (commit e2b7f1c)
deploy-bot: notes: adaptive batching tweak + kv-cache ttl adjustment. release notes: https://ci.redwood/release/3.2.4
ania: noticed small tail latency rise in eu-central at 45s, 95p up ~120ms :thinking:
reno: error rate looks flat but p99 tails drifting. any change to tokenization or padding?
harper: not tokenization. batching policy bumped threshold to favor larger batches under low qps, could affect kv retention
kai: traces: several requests show repeated KV misses then evictions, GC spikes on infer hosts
devops-bot: alert: eu-central infer-host-12 memory pressure -> reclaimed 30s ago (incident id ic-433331)
ania: recommend quick check: reduce rollout to 0% for eu-central and pin region back to v3.2.3 while we investigate
harper: agree. regional pin is low-risk. if we pin, can we keep other regions at 5%?
kai: yes, routing supports per-region percent. do regional pin and keep global percent untouched
reno: what's the cost of a regional pin vs rollback? any sticky sessions?
kai: pin is just a routing rewrite (no host restart). rollback would be same but global. pin localizes blast radius
devops-bot: proposed commands:
```
redwood rollout set --commit e2b7f1c --region eu-central --percent 0 --reason "pause: kv evict spike"
redwood route set --region eu-central --from v3.2.4 --to v3.2.3 --force
```
deploy-bot: executed commands at 4333312352, v3.2.4 traffic in eu-central -> 0%
ania: metrics update: 95p and p99 trending back toward baseline in 20s, memory pressure easing :thumbsup:
reno: capture failing sample set for postmortem and fuzzing: s3://canary-replays/4333312345/evict-samples.tar.gz
harper: followups: add kv-cache eviction test to the smoke suite, and add a small-bake with synthetic tail sequences before next rollout
kai: will open infra ticket to tune batching heuristic, assign to serving-runtime team
devops-bot: release notes updated: "eu-central partial rollout paused; pinned back to v3.2.3 pending batching/kv investigation"
ania: i'll own hotfix prototype branch and aim for next small-bake in 48h
reno: decision: regional pause + pin. no org-wide rollback. escalate if other regions show similar signals
deploy-bot: logging: thread closed at 4333312360. if needed, re-open with `redwood deploy reopen --thread 4333312345`
ania: thanks everyone. ping me for pairing on repro datasets.
